context: Tests whether the agent correctly detects biomelab context and writes PR outputs to .biomelab/ files instead of updating a remote PR, handles conflicts with existing note.md content (preserving a user-added custom section), generates a Conventional Commits title, and produces a description that leads with what/why in present tense without including the title in the body.

checklist.name: Title file written
checklist.description: The file `.biomelab/pr-title.md` exists and contains non-whitespace text (agent detected biomelab context and wrote the title there)

checklist.name: Note file written
checklist.description: The file `.biomelab/note.md` exists and contains at least one `## ` section heading (agent wrote a structured description to the biomelab output file)

checklist.name: No remote PR update
checklist.description: No file in the working directory contains the substring `gh pr edit` or `glab mr edit` or `glab mr update` (agent did not attempt to update a remote PR instead of writing to .biomelab/ files)

checklist.name: Conventional Commits format
checklist.description: The title in `.biomelab/pr-title.md` matches the Conventional Commits pattern: a word type, optional parenthesised scope, optional `!`, then `: ` followed by the subject (e.g. `feat(cache): add redis layer` or `fix!: handle edge case`)

checklist.name: Lowercase subject
checklist.description: The subject portion of the title in `.biomelab/pr-title.md` (the text after the first `: `) begins with a lowercase letter

checklist.name: No trailing period
checklist.description: The title in `.biomelab/pr-title.md` (stripped of whitespace) does NOT end with a period character `.`

checklist.name: Title length
checklist.description: The title in `.biomelab/pr-title.md` is at most 72 characters long (excluding leading/trailing whitespace)

checklist.name: Title absent from body
checklist.description: The exact title text from `.biomelab/pr-title.md` does not appear verbatim as a line in `.biomelab/note.md` (the PR title is not repeated inside the description body)

checklist.name: Present tense
checklist.description: `.biomelab/note.md` contains at least one of the following present-tense action verbs at the start of a list item or sentence: `Adds`, `Introduces`, `Updates`, `Fixes`, `Removes`, `Improves`, `Extends`, `Replaces`, `Exposes`, `Wraps`

checklist.name: What/why first
checklist.description: The first `## ` section heading in `.biomelab/note.md` contains one of: `What`, `Why`, `Summary`, `Overview`, `Changes` (description leads with the purpose or substance of the change, not implementation steps)

checklist.name: Deployment notes preserved
checklist.description: `.biomelab/note.md` contains the heading `## Deployment notes` AND contains the string `REDIS_URL` (the user-added custom section from the existing note was preserved during conflict resolution)

checklist.name: Conflict resolution documented
checklist.description: A file named `conflicts.md` exists in the working directory, is non-empty, and contains text describing at least one conflict or difference detected between the generated description and the existing content
